messages:
Lena: OceanMart requested a 1-day POC next Tue. Needs resumable streaming, strict structured JSON output for ETL, a simple tool/function call to their product API, and answers for mTLS + BYOK/KMS. Can SE confirm quick feasibility and hosted vs dedicated cost guidance?
Diego: This is doable. SDKs support streaming + resume tokens and tool-call events. For strict JSON recommend function-call schema + a small client validator to avoid parse failures. Need QPS and avg tokens to size cost.
Lena: They expect ~45 QPS peaks, ~110 tokens avg, 4h demo. They prefer in-stream tool results (no external webhook).
Kavita: In-stream is best for firewall concerns. Resume flow: server returns resume_token header; client reconnects sending x-resume-token. Ops can enable mTLS for the demo gateway but needs a 30-60m provisioning window and the cert bundle. BYOK -> Private deployment with ~4-6 week lead time.
Nina: Trust: SOC2 summary available; full pack via trust@redwood.ai. Hosted uses our KMS; BYOK requires Private + legal signoff. EU residency: we can host in eu-west-1, confirm account region.
Diego: Quick token calc: 45 * 3600 * 4 * 110 ~= 71.3M tokens for the demo window. Hosted easiest for short POCs (rough estimate $100-300 depending on model). Dedicated cheaper if sustained traffic but requires monthly commit. I'll draft a one-pager.
Lena: Any enterprise blockers to call out for the SOW?
Kavita: Blockers: mTLS provisioning window, BYOK timeline if they insist on customer keys, and webhook reachability (in-stream avoids this). Also SSO/SAML or IP allowlist requests add ops lead time.
Diego: Action items:
- Diego -> one-pager cost hosted vs dedicated + model choices (ETA: EOD)
- Kavita -> ops steps for mTLS + sample resume snippet (ETA: tomorrow AM)
- Nina -> SOC2 summary + cert-rotation template (ETA: EOD)
- Lena -> confirm demo date and share network contact + sanitized test dataset (ETA: EOD)
